issues.title: Avoid `Connection Status` warning message
issues.body:
For some users, their Serge instance mistakenly thought the server was down.

The server didn't go down once.

From watching the `Network` dialog in `Chrome Developer Tools`, it was clear that one heartbeat request wasn't being answered.  The next few heartbeat messages also queued up at 5 second intervals.  Eventually the first heartbeat was reported as `failed`, but the following ones were responded to.

This _may_ be a client comms issue, or it _may_ be an issue with a queue of heartbeats at the server.

Suggest we overcome it by reducing heartbeat to once every 20 seconds.
